rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Long-haired water guardian in mermaid manifestation.

visual_requirements.description: Mermaid manifestation with long hair; human upper body clothed opaque and one fish tail.
Rocky stream pool, nature guardian habitat.

aura: Keagungan guardian melalui wujud mermaid dan rambut panjang (simbi-c02, simbi-c13), cipratan hanya gerak fisik bukan manipulasi air.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
Mermaid c02 and long hair c13 selected without mixing snake, gourd or fire forms; opaque cloth and lighting are editorial. No control of water inferred from water domain.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of SIMBI, a Bakongo water-and-nature guardian in documented mermaid manifestation [simbi-c02].
ANATOMY: ONE dark-skinned humanlike female upper body, ONE head with very long wet hair [simbi-c13], TWO arms, exactly ONE powerful scaled FISH TAIL instead of legs, broad split tail fin; fully opaque dark earth-brown cloth wraps and covers torso completely to waist, no exposed breasts; mermaid form c02, not a generic human.
MOMENT: surging upward from a rocky stream pool, twisting a powerful fish tail close across foreground and bracing one hand on a slick rock; other hand lifted in firm guardian gesture, intense solemn gaze down toward viewer. Tail remains visibly attached at waist, fin splashes behind.
POWER: no invented water control or magic beams. Ordinary water displacement physically follows the mermaid's sudden movement; protection expressed through guard stance only.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low intimate angle from pool surface, face and fish tail dominate square, no undocumented giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm late sunlight shaft through dark trees catches water on cheek and scales, deep shadows, real spray and water droplets.
SURFACE: wet dark copper-brown scales, long textured black hair, rough opaque cloth, slick ancient rock.
SETTING: stream and pool among rocks, habitat of Simbi nature guardians [simbi-c09,c20].
MOOD: sacred and awe-inspiring protective nature presence, respectful living Bakongo tradition, active and imposing rather than decorative or romantic.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, legs, arms or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
